"""Reusable desktop sizing, wrapping controls and scrollable content."""
import re
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk


def window_bounds(screen_width, screen_height, saved="", default=(1180, 720),
                  minimum=(800, 540)):
    """Clamp saved dimensions and center the window inside the current screen."""
    available_width = max(1, int(screen_width) - 40)
    available_height = max(1, int(screen_height) - 100)
    min_width = min(minimum[0], available_width)
    min_height = min(minimum[1], available_height)
    width, height = default
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)x(\d+)(?:[+-]\d+[+-]\d+)?", str(saved or ""))
    if match:
        width, height = map(int, match.groups())
    width = min(available_width, max(min_width, width))
    height = min(available_height, max(min_height, height))
    left = max(0, (int(screen_width) - width) // 2)
    top = max(0, (int(screen_height) - height) // 2 - 20)
    return width, height, left, top, min_width, min_height


def size_window(window, saved="", default=(1180, 720), minimum=(800, 540)):
    width, height, left, top, min_width, min_height = window_bounds(
        window.winfo_screenwidth(), window.winfo_screenheight(), saved, default, minimum)
    window.minsize(min_width, min_height)
    window.geometry(f"{width}x{height}+{left}+{top}")
    window.resizable(True, True)


def flow_positions(sizes, width, gap=6):
    """Return control rectangles in reading order plus the required row height."""
    width = max(1, int(width))
    x = y = row_height = 0
    positions = []
    for requested_width, requested_height in sizes:
        item_width = min(width, max(1, int(requested_width)))
        item_height = max(1, int(requested_height))
        if x and x + item_width > width:
            x = 0
            y += row_height + gap
            row_height = 0
        positions.append((x, y, item_width, item_height))
        x += item_width + gap
        row_height = max(row_height, item_height)
    return positions, max(1, y + row_height)


class FlowFrame(ttk.Frame):
    """Controls wrap to more rows when the frame becomes narrower."""
    def __init__(self, parent, gap=6, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(parent, **kwargs)
        self._items = []
        self._gap = gap
        self._pending = None
        self.bind("<Configure>", self._queue, add="+")
        self.bind("<Destroy>", self._destroyed, add="+")

    def add(self, widget):
        if widget.master is not self:
            raise ValueError("Flow controls must belong to their FlowFrame")
        self._items.append(widget)
        self._queue()
        return widget

    def _queue(self, event=None):
        if self._pending is None:
            self._pending = self.after_idle(self._layout)

    def _layout(self):
        self._pending = None
        if not self.winfo_exists() or self.winfo_width() < 2:
            return
        self._items = [item for item in self._items if item.winfo_exists()]
        sizes = [(item.winfo_reqwidth(), item.winfo_reqheight()) for item in self._items]
        positions, height = flow_positions(sizes, self.winfo_width(), self._gap)
        for item, (x, y, width, item_height) in zip(self._items, positions):
            item.place(x=x, y=y, width=width, height=item_height)
        if self.winfo_pixels(str(self.cget("height"))) != height:
            self.configure(height=height)

    def _destroyed(self, event):
        if event.widget is self and self._pending is not None:
            self.after_cancel(self._pending)
            self._pending = None


def scrollable_text(parent, **kwargs):
    """Create a resizable read/copy text area with visible scroll controls."""
    frame = ttk.Frame(parent)
    frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
    frame.rowconfigure(0, weight=1)
    frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    kwargs.setdefault("wrap", "word")
    text = tk.Text(frame, **kwargs)
    vertical = ttk.Scrollbar(frame, orient="vertical", command=text.yview)
    text.configure(yscrollcommand=vertical.set)
    text.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew")
    vertical.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ns")
    if kwargs["wrap"] == "none":
        horizontal = ttk.Scrollbar(frame, orient="horizontal", command=text.xview)
        text.configure(xscrollcommand=horizontal.set)
        horizontal.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    return text


def scrollable_tree(parent, **kwargs):
    frame = ttk.Frame(parent)
    frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
    frame.rowconfigure(0, weight=1)
    frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    tree = ttk.Treeview(frame, **kwargs)
    vertical = ttk.Scrollbar(frame, orient="vertical", command=tree.yview)
    horizontal = ttk.Scrollbar(frame, orient="horizontal", command=tree.xview)
    tree.configure(yscrollcommand=vertical.set, xscrollcommand=horizontal.set)
    tree.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew")
    vertical.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ns")
    horizontal.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    return tree


def wrapping_label(parent, **kwargs):
    kwargs.setdefault("wraplength", 600)
    label = ttk.Label(parent, **kwargs)
    label.pack(fill="x", pady=3)

    def resized(event):
        label.configure(wraplength=max(1, event.width - 24))

    label.bind("<Configure>", resized, add="+")
    return label
